description: Paid per call in USDC (x402), flat price per date. NHL pre-game probabilities for every game of the date that has not started: home win, home -1.5 and away -1.5, from a model that takes no market odds as input, with starting goalies when known and a timestamp. Dates: today to two days ahead (US Eastern). Not charged when the API returns an error.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, US Eastern game day; default today
